entries.title: Four-Cylinder Piston Engine Cross-Section
entries.description: A transparent engine block holds four color-coded pistons that slide up and down in cylinders, with a rotating crankshaft, connecting rods, intake and exhaust valves that open and close, fuel-air particles that enter and combust as glowing bursts, and labeled gauges showing RPM and pressure.

entries.title: Jet Turbofan Engine Airflow
entries.description: A cutaway turbofan engine with spinning front fan blades, compressor and turbine stages, where air particles (tiny colored spheres) flow through, accelerate, compress, heat up (color-shifting from blue to red), and exhaust as a high-speed jet plume, with trails showing airflow paths and labels for each section.

entries.title: Rocket Engine Test Stand
entries.description: A vertically mounted rocket engine attached to a fixed test stand, with fuel and oxidizer lines feeding into a combustion chamber that ignites into a bright exhaust plume of particles, while a thrust meter bar rises and falls, the nozzle glows red with heat, and translucent shock diamonds pulse in the exhaust.

entries.title: Steam Engine With Flywheel
entries.description: A classic steam engine where steam (white particle clouds) enters a cylinder, pushes a piston connected to a large rotating flywheel, with a sliding valve mechanism that alternates steam flow, a pressure gauge needle that swings, and motion trails on the flywheel’s rim to show rotational speed.

entries.title: Electric Motor and Generator Pair

entries.title: Gear Train Engine Room
